name: MKTG 3370
title: Global Marketing Strategy
description: (Also offered as BADM 3370.) This course focuses on developing sound marketing strategies in the global marketplace. Students learn to uncover and assess global market opportunities; analyze challenges and solutions posed by cultural, economic, and political differences; and develop effective international marketing strategies considering legal, ethical, and social sustainability issues. Students gain experience conducting research on global markets and applying their knowledge in complex business settings.
requirement_description: MKTG 3101 or BADM 3750; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
